summary: Scheduled frontage, boulevard-edge and parking-island care for a multi-tenant business park.
scope: Parking island bed care and mulch
Issue reports to the property manager
challenge: A multi-tenant business park needed grounds work finished before tenants' trucks filled the lot each morning.
approach: We scheduled early-morning visits and kept a short checklist for each area of the site.
When the crew found a damaged sprinkler line and a dying shrub row, they reported both in writing with photos so the property manager could decide on repairs.
result: Work finished around tenant hours, with issues reported in writing.
